app.name: VitaForge
app.tagline: A personal training plan with safety first
notice.experimental: Development preview: data and exercises are samples and have not been expert-reviewed. Not medical advice.
notice.notMedical: This app is not medical advice and does not replace consulting a professional.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with an uppercase letter and a digit.
auth.adultsOnly: This app is for adults (18+) only.
auth.login.title: Log in
auth.register.title: Create an account
auth.register.have: Already have an account? Log in
auth.register.done: Your sign-up request was recorded. If email verification is required, enter the code on the next step; otherwise you can log in.
auth.verify.title: Verify email
auth.verify.done: Email verified. You can log in now.
error.validation_failed: The information entered is not valid.
error.auth_failed: The email or password is wrong, or the account is not verified yet.
error.account_locked: The account is temporarily locked; try again later.
error.conflict: This request conflicts with the current state.
error.not_found: The requested item was not found.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
error.quota_or_plan_required: Your current plan does not include this feature.
error.needs_content: There are not yet enough reviewed exercises for your equipment and restrictions.
error.feature_unavailable: This feature is not available yet.
error.gone: This code or link has expired.
error.consent_required: Valid consent for health-data processing is required.
error.csrf_failed: Your session has expired; refresh the page and log in again.
onb.title: Onboarding
onb.equipment.hint: If you select nothing, only bodyweight exercises are considered.
consent.title: Consent to health-data processing
consent.accept: I consent to my health data being processed to build a safe plan.
consent.mustAccept: A plan cannot be built without this consent.
consent.noDoc: The consent document is not available.
screening.title: Initial warning-sign screening
screening.intro: These questions are for your safety only and are not a medical diagnosis. If any answer is “Yes”, no plan will be built and you will be advised to consult a professional.
screening.q.chest_pain: Chest pain during activity or at rest
screening.q.severe_unexplained_pain: Severe pain with no clear cause
screening.q.neurological_symptoms: Neurological symptoms (e.g. sudden numbness or weakness)
onb.finish.title: You are ready
onb.finish.body: Your information is saved. Continue to build your plan.
plan.title: Training plan
plan.empty: No plan has been built yet.
plan.modified: This plan was limited or adjusted based on your safety information.
decision.NEEDS_INFO.title: More information is needed
decision.NEEDS_INFO.body: To build a safe plan, first answer the questions below.
decision.STOP_AND_REFER.title: No plan was built
decision.STOP_AND_REFER.body: Based on your answers, please consult a doctor or professional before exercising.
decision.BLOCK_OUT_OF_SCOPE.title: Outside this app's scope
decision.BLOCK_OUT_OF_SCOPE.body: Your recorded situation is outside this app's scope; consult a professional.
decision.BLOCK_CONSENT.title: Consent is required
decision.BLOCK_CONSENT.body: No plan is built without valid consent to health-data processing.
decision.ERROR_FAILSAFE.title: No plan was built, for safety
decision.ERROR_FAILSAFE.body: An error occurred during the safety check, so no plan was built as a precaution. Try again later.
decision.blocked.title: No plan was built
decision.blocked.body: The safety check did not allow a plan to be built.
decision.referral.unreviewed: The text of this referral has not been expert-reviewed yet.
session.expired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
consent.draftNotice: This text is a draft that has not been legally reviewed; it is not valid for real use.
plan.noUnreviewed: No unapproved exercise is ever shown in a plan.
error.phone_registration_not_supported: Sign-up with a phone number is not supported yet.
error.under_18: This app is for ages 18 and over.
decision.RESTRICT.title: No valid exercise remains
decision.RESTRICT.body: Given your safety information and equipment, no approved exercise remains to build a plan. No plan was built; consult a professional if needed.
plan.experimental.title: Experimental content — not reviewed
plan.experimental.body: The exercises in this plan come from development sample data: the texts have not been expert-reviewed and carry no medical or scientific approval. For development display only; do not use for real training.
